newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, PMIndia, news) for NSAP changes: the Cabinet decision of 14 Oct 2026 (PIB Release 2323264, snapshot in content) continues NSAP 2026-27 to 2030-31 as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana, renames the sub-schemes, revises the disability pension (Rs 375 / Rs 625, 40% benchmark disability, from birth, guidelines within three months) and continues the old-age, widow and family benefit schemes in their existing form. No revised disability-pension guidelines found as of 26 Oct 2026. Widow pension renamed Pradhan Mantri Vidhawa Pension Yojana; eligibility (40+) and amounts (Rs 300, Rs 500 from 80) unchanged.

findings.note: Rs 300 and Rs 500 from age 80 match the guideline quote; age_min >= 40 matches. Fixtures cover 39/40/41, bands, married, male and missing fields. Text now third person; Hindi matches.
The quote is the IGNWPS line, which does not literally say 'female'; the condition follows from 'widow'. Logic is right.
findings.suggestion: Optionally quote 'pension to widows below poverty line'.

findings.note: ration_card, bank_account and aadhaar now optional, consistent with para 5.2.12.

Hard 'confirmed' rule on is_bpl, whose question asks about a BPL/Antyodaya ration card. Guidelines para 3.1.3 say an eligible person missing from the BPL list should not be left out; a 'no' gives a firm NOT_ELIGIBLE. how_to_apply mitigates this where it carries the note.
